description: Discover the best hotels in Hoi An, Vietnam. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Five-Star Hoi An Opulence on Hoai River with Restaurant, Bar & Pool with Ancient Town Views
hotels.description: Retreat to the banks of the Hoai River at this enchanting escape designed to embrace the very best of this vibrant Vietnamese town. With hints of local architecture intertwined with sleek modern features, this charming hotel is the perfect riverside abode, just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hoi An Ancient Town. Savour Mediterranean flavours at the onsite restaurant, sip cocktails by the pool and take a moment of rest at Breathe Spa - here, there's no reason to rush.

hotels.vendor_name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa
hotels.title: Hoi An Oceanfront Serenity with Onsite Dining, Outdoor Pool & Private Beach
hotels.description: Step through traditional Vietnamese doors to discover this serene retreat where a sprawling pool flows among palm-fringed gardens, framed by a long stretch of pristine private beach. Lose track of time while gliding through the water on a kayak, escape to the ultra-tranquil Victoria Spa for a treatment or catch a film at the onsite cinema. Savour Asian and European dishes at the L’Annam Restaurant, unwind poolside with a tropical tipple from Faifo Bar or enjoy a game of billiards at Elephant Bar. When it’s time to venture into town, the quaint streets and canals of the UNESCO heritage-listed Hoi An Ancient Town are just 15-minutes away.

hotels.vendor_name: Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Danang
hotels.title: Hoi An Beachfront Bliss with Massages, Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Nightly Free-Flow Drinks Hour
hotels.description: Experience a magical slice of Vietnam's coastline with a five-star stay at Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang. Set on pristine shores, this luxurious resort is a tranquil oasis, gracefully located on the golden sands between Da Nang and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Hoi An Old Town. Sink your toes into the soft sand of An Bang Beach, where you’ll have a front-row seat to golden sunrises, and enjoy the resort’s state-of-the-art facilities, including the tranquil Sense Spa and sprawling infinity pool. Treat your palate to authentic Vietnamese cuisine at the resort’s onsite restaurant, or venture out to explore the vibrant local food scene at Hoi An’s night market. The resort’s prime location also puts you within easy reach of the region’s top attractions. Take a leisurely bike ride through the lush rice fields, visit the historic Japanese Covered Bridge, or explore the colourful lantern-lit streets of Hoi An Old Town before heading back to the resort for a nightcap at Aura Bar.

hotels.vendor_name: Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Danang
hotels.title: Hoi An Beachfront Haven with Gourmet Dining, Rooftop Bar, Infinity Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Experience the magic of Vietnam’s ancient town with a five-star stay at Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Danang. Set on the pristine shores of the South China Sea, this luxurious resort is a tranquil oasis located on the golden sands between Da Nang and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Hoi An Old Town. Sink your toes into the soft sand of An Bang Beach, where you’ll have a front-row seat to golden sunrises, and enjoy the resort’s state-of-the-art facilities, including the tranquil Royal Retreat Spa and sprawling infinity pool. Treat your palate to authentic Vietnamese cuisine at the resort's many onsite restaurants, or venture out to explore the vibrant local food scene at Hoi An Night Market. Take a leisurely bike ride through the lush rice fields, visit the historic Japanese Covered Bridge, or explore the colourful lantern-lit streets of Hoi An’s Old Town before heading back to the resort for a nightcap at Chill Sky Bar.
